keys.name: CROOKED_LOAD
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Rear-right-loaded crouch; left shoulder already aimed at travel line.

keys.name: SUPPORT_BREAK
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Rear foot punch breaks support; root commits up-right.

keys.name: KNIFE_ASCENT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Asymmetric ascent; leading shoulder narrow, trailing leg stretched.

keys.name: PREWALL_TURN
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Body starts yawing before wall; forearm folds into a glance guard.

keys.name: WALL_GLANCE
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Forearm reaches wall at a clear authored contact instant; normal impulse arrests lateral travel and begins yaw without granting support.

keys.name: WALL_SHEAR
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Forearm stays on wall while root shears downward; hips pass under the contact and trailing leg whips. Wall never owns the root.

keys.name: PEEL
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Contact releases; body peels down-left, no upward rebound.

keys.name: FLOOR_PRECONTACT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Left leg reaches under root while right leg and shoulder lag.

keys.name: TOE_BALL_CATCH
keys.motion_arc_root_note: First floor support acquired while root still descends/left.

keys.name: ONE_SIDED_CRUSH
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Left knee absorbs; right side remains airborne and late.

keys.name: LAG_OVERSHOOT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Right foot arrives after crush; shoulders sling past hips.

keys.name: CHASE_RECOVERY
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Chase step catches displaced root; body still twisted.

keys.name: DISPLACED_SETTLE
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Settles left of launch with residual shoulder skew; no idle reset.

compile.bridge_rule: smoothstep geometry only; contact/support remains source key state until next decisive authored key

tango_rounds.defect: wall-glance causal event is under-read because the authored contact limb stops short of the wall, making the direction change look like an unexplained mid-air turn
tango_rounds.correction: extend the leading forearm to an explicit wall endpoint in K4 and keep that endpoint visibly constrained through K5 while root drops tangentially; preserve support=NONE

tango_rounds.finding: explicit forearm endpoint reaches wall; sustained shear makes direction change causal; root keeps descending through contact, then peels down-left into delayed one-foot floor catch; asymmetric crush, shoulder overshoot, chase step and displaced settle remain legible

noodle_queen.taste: hard forearm wall scrape into crooked peel creates a specific silhouette sequence rather than a generic jump
noodle_queen.function: load → support break → ascent → prewall yaw → forearm glance → wall shear → peel → floor prep → one-foot catch → crush → overshoot → chase → displaced settle reads causally
noodle_queen.contempt: wall contact never grants magical support, recovery does not reverse the flight or return to idle, and the body pays both angular and lateral debt
